title: Questions Are Your Friend: Q&A Strategies
objective: Students learn polite, confident responses when answering presentation questions.
context: Your team counted 11 bees in a park and 4 in a field on one day. An audience member asks, “Where did you see more bees? Is it always like that?”

items.prompt: Ask the speaker to repeat or clarify part of the question.
items.answer: Accept a polite request that mentions which part of the question needs clarification.
items.hint: Try: Could you repeat the part about ___?

items.prompt: Answer the first question directly. Include both counts.
items.answer: We saw more bees in the park: 11 compared with 4 in the field.
items.hint: Start with the place. Then give the numbers.

items.prompt: Answer the second question. Give one limit and one next step.
items.answer: One day cannot show a usual pattern. Accept a plan to repeat the observation on other days.
items.hint: Try: We do not know yet because ___. Next we could ___.
